positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Headed all development phases at the Shared Services business unit to accomplish the fully operational independence between the company business units(KueskiCash, KueskiPay & KueskiUp).
* Build & manage all the infrastructure of the Shared Services BU orchestrating Docker containers using Kubernetes through Gitlab/Github pipelines.
* In charge of all the solution for a Disbursement Service through different banks(BBVA, STP).

positions.title: Senior / Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead of the new strategic business unit, Shared Services; leading two engineering teams.
* In charge of all the solution for a Financial Ecosystem, including the development of a Fraud Service and a Loan Management System.
* In charge of design, guidance and development of solutions to improve the integration of analytics models developed by the Data Scientist team.
* Headed all development phases of Cross Selling project. 
* ASML Digital Gold Hackathon 2018.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Ontario 1090, Italia Providencia, Guadalajara, Jalisco, México CP. 44648
